test_cases.name: Valid Customer Registration
test_cases.description: Register a new customer with all required fields and valid data.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Registration successful, user receives confirmation email and can log in.

test_cases.name: Registration Missing Email
test_cases.description: Attempt to register without providing an email address.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Error returned: 'Email is required.' Registration fails.

test_cases.name: Registration Username Minimum Length Boundary
test_cases.description: Register with username at the minimum allowed length (3 characters).

test_cases.name: View Services After Login
test_cases.description: View list of available services after successful authentication.
test_cases.expected_outcome: List of services displayed with details.

test_cases.name: View Services Without Authentication
test_cases.description: Attempt to view services without providing an authentication token.

test_cases.name: View Services When No Services Available
test_cases.description: View services when the system has no services configured.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Empty list returned with message: 'No services available at this time.'

test_cases.name: Choose Appointment Slot - Valid Slot
test_cases.description: Select an available appointment time for a chosen service.

test_cases.name: Choose Appointment Slot - Slot Already Booked
test_cases.description: Attempt to book an appointment time that has already been taken.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Error returned: 'Selected time slot is no longer available.' Booking fails.

test_cases.name: Choose Appointment Slot at Earliest Allowed Time
test_cases.description: Book an appointment at the earliest time the salon opens (e.g., 09:00).
test_cases.expected_outcome: Appointment reserved successfully at earliest slot.

test_cases.name: Online Payment - Valid Credit Card
test_cases.description: Pay for an appointment using a valid credit card.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Payment processed, confirmation received, appointment marked as paid.

test_cases.name: Online Payment - Invalid Card Number
test_cases.description: Attempt to pay with an invalid credit card number.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Error returned: 'Invalid card number.' Payment rejected.

test_cases.name: Online Payment at Minimum Amount Boundary
test_cases.expected_outcome: Payment processed successfully at minimum amount.

test_cases.name: Cancel Appointment Within Allowed Window
test_cases.description: Cancel an appointment before the cancellation deadline.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Appointment cancelled, confirmation sent, refund processed if applicable.

test_cases.name: Cancel Appointment After Deadline
test_cases.description: Attempt to cancel an appointment after the cancellation deadline has passed.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Error returned: 'Cancellation period has expired.' Cancellation denied.

test_cases.name: Cancel Appointment Exactly at Deadline
test_cases.description: Cancel an appointment at the exact moment the cancellation deadline ends.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Cancellation denied with message: 'Cancellation period has expired.'
